entities.summary: Santa Teresa di Gesù Bambino is a place of Roman Catholic worship, or sanctuary, in Verona, Italy. Located in the southern outskirts of the city, in the Borgo Roma District, entrusted to the Discalced Carmelites. Construction began in 1901, was completed in 1904 and the church was consecrated the following year.
